 The Department of Justice ended a legal challenge to change the Public Service Loan Forgiveness program last Wednesday.
 The intended change would have made it so student loans could be cut off to people if the Trump administration found their employer to be engaged in activities with a “substantial illegal purpose," such as supporting undocumented immigrants or transgender youth healthcare.
